evidence: Current title: Window icon doesn't behave like standard Windows applications

Current report excerpt: ### Microsoft PowerToys version

0.76.2

### Installation method

Microsoft Store

### Running as admin

No

### Area(s) with issue?

General, Settings, Welcome / PowerToys Tour window

### Steps to reproduce

* Left-click the PowerToys window icon at the top-left of the PowerToys Settings or Welcome window.
* Double-click the window icon.
* Right-click the middle of the title bar.

### ✔️ Expected Behavior

As with other standard Windows apps:
* Left-clicking the window icon should open the window menu with the “Close” option bolded.
* Double-clicking the window icon should close the window.
* Right-clicking the middle of the title bar should open the window menu with the “Maximize” option bolded.

### ❌ Actual Behavior

* Left-clicking the PowerToys window icon does nothing.
* Double-clicking the window icon maximizes the window.
* Right-clicking the middle of the title bar open...
